_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::electrochemistry#5, and the execution that CORRECTED it. The rule holds — S2I coupling needs both the dynamics subsection and the interface conditions — but the entry's section name and its Signal are both wrong. 'DESIGN SURF S2I COUPLING CONDITIONS' is not a section name on this build ('is not a valid section name.'); the real ones are DESIGN S2I KINETICS / DESIGN S2I MESHTYING <SURF|LINE> CONDITIONS (REAL_CONDITION_SECTIONS=2 in upstream elch_2D_quad4_s2i_butlervolmer_cycling, which passes 16 result tests). Omitting the kinetics block does not 'compile but never apply the BV kinetics': it aborts with "For each 'S2IKinetics' or 'S2ISCLCoupling' condition a corresponding 'S2IMeshtying' or 'S2INoEvaluation' condition has to be defined!" from src/scatra/4C_scatra_utils.cpp. Omitting SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/S2I COUPLING instead aborts with 'Type of mortar meshtying for scatra-scatra interface coupling not recognized!' from src/scatra/4C_scatra_timint_meshtying_strategy_s2i.cpp. Neither omission reaches a result test, so there is no silent ~0 electrode current to look for. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: For each 'S2IKinetics' or 'S2ISCLCoupling' condition a corresponding 'S2IMeshtying' or 'S2INoEvaluation' condition has to be defined!
Type of mortar meshtying for scatra-scatra interface coupling not recognized!
Section 'DESIGN SURF S2I COUPLING CONDITIONS' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the kinetics arm: keep the condition block. Its abort disappears, EXIT_NO_KINETICS becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the dynamics arm: keep SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/S2I COUPLING. Its abort disappears, EXIT_NO_S2I_SECTION becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the name arm: leave the real section name in place. The 'not a valid section name' line disappears and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from:
t.replace("DESIGN S2I KINETICS LINE CONDITIONS:",
              "DESIGN SURF S2I COUPLING CONDITIONS:"))
